nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page HTML shell for the admin dashboard with an SVG icon sprite, a token login form (with optional Gmail login), and the app layout with topbar, target switch (local/VPS), nav and main area populated by admin_page.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese-language UI; loads theme.js, theme.css, admin_page.css and a deferred admin_page.js.

nodes.name: admin_page.css
nodes.summary: Admin page layout and component styles (grid layout, topbar, headings, chat bubbles, status colors) built on top of the theme.css design tokens.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: Shared 'iforgotmywayhome' ancient-architecture theme: self-hosted font-face declarations, dark default and light color tokens, and base styles for buttons, inputs and stone-like cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Copied from the quanlythoigian repo; light mode via html[data-theme=light].
